name: two-step iterative algorithm
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将耦合问题分为两个步骤并反复协调求解的算法。

complete_examples.text: In the solution, a two-step iterative algorithm is developed to solve the vehicle–track interaction, which is the iterative solution between the vehicle–rail subsystem and the track slab system as shown in Figure 2 and the iterative solution for deriving the elastoplastic dynamics solution of the track slab system.
With this, a two-step iterative algorithm with detailed presentation of mathematical formulations is developed to solve the dynamic equations of motion for vehicle–track interactions.
